# Fravalu

> AI and workflow automation consultancy for SMEs without an in-house IT implementation team. Based in Rotterdam, Netherlands (KVK 42095902).

Fravalu audits how a business actually runs, produces a ranked and costed plan for what is worth automating, and builds the first workflow on that list to prove it. The plan is the client's to keep whether or not a build follows. Engagements run in a fixed order: map the repeated work, rank and price each process, build the workflow that pays back first, then measure the saving against what was projected.

Fixed price per workflow, agreed before building starts. Built with widely used tools inside the client's existing systems; the client owns the code.

## Results

Done as a Solutions Architect at Mesh Bio (Singapore) and in an MBA consulting project, not as Fravalu client work.

- Clinic data: time per file improved from about 1 hour to 6-10 minutes, including human review, for more than 30 clinics. The first version had at least one attribute wrong in 70% of records; after the fix, 99% of the data went to the live database.
- Onboarding: new lab and clinic onboarding improved from 3-5 days to under 1 day with a configuration-driven AWS pipeline that handled about 10,000 records an hour in Singapore and is still in use across five markets.
- First overseas customer: recommended an API-based workflow, scoped it to the deadline and led three weeks of on-site deployment; the customer became a lighthouse account with follow-on regional projects. Later built and led a team of three solutions engineers.
- Portfolio monitoring: designed a five-stage AI monitoring workflow for an impact investor with a five-person MBA team, projected to improve monitoring time by about 45%.

## Founder

Ahmed Alvee. Three and a half years at Mesh Bio in Singapore (2022 to 2025), where he became a Solutions Architect leading a team of three solutions engineers. AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate. Completing an MBA at Rotterdam School of Management.
